description: Flat per-sample metadata schema for soil microbial sequencing studies from agricultural fields, capturing soil properties, sampling context, agricultural practices, nucleic acid extraction, sequencing, and processing details.

sample_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual soil sample record.

project_id.descr: Identifier linking the sample to a study or project.

field_id.descr: Identifier for the agricultural field or plot from which the sample was collected.

country.descr: Country where the sample was collected.

region.descr: State, province, county, or broader administrative region.

latitude.descr: Sampling location latitude in decimal degrees (WGS84).

longitude.descr: Sampling location longitude in decimal degrees (WGS84).

elevation_m.descr: Sampling elevation above sea level in meters.

sampling_date.descr: Date the soil sample was collected (YYYY-MM-DD).

sampling_depth_cm.descr: Depth interval of sampling in centimeters, reported as a single depth or midpoint when appropriate.

soil_horizon.descr: Soil horizon or layer sampled, if known (e.g., A horizon, topsoil).

sampling_method.descr: Method used to collect the soil sample (e.g., soil corer, auger, shovel, rhizosphere collection).

sampled_mass_g.descr: Mass of soil collected for the record, in grams.

sample_storage_condition.descr: Condition used to store the sample before extraction (e.g., frozen at -80 C, on ice, room temperature short-term).

sample_storage_duration_h.descr: Time between collection and nucleic acid extraction or freezing, in hours.

soil_texture.descr: Soil texture classification or dominant texture class (e.g., sandy loam, clay loam).

soil_pH.descr: Soil pH measurement, including method-specific context if needed.

soil_moisture_content_pct.descr: Soil moisture content as percent wet weight or gravimetric water content, reported as percent.

soil_organic_matter_pct.descr: Soil organic matter content as percent.

soil_organic_carbon_pct.descr: Soil organic carbon content as percent, if measured.

soil_total_nitrogen_pct.descr: Total nitrogen content as percent, if measured.

soil_bulk_density_g_cm3.descr: Soil bulk density in grams per cubic centimeter, if measured.

soil_electrical_conductivity_ds_m.descr: Soil electrical conductivity in dS/m, if measured.

soil_nitrate_mg_kg.descr: Soil nitrate concentration in mg/kg, if measured.

soil_ammonium_mg_kg.descr: Soil ammonium concentration in mg/kg, if measured.

crop_type.descr: Crop species or crop category grown in the field at the time of sampling.

agricultural_practice.descr: Primary management practice relevant to the sample, such as conventional tillage, no-till, organic farming, crop rotation, irrigation regime, or fertilization regime.

fertilizer_applied.descr: Whether fertilizer was applied to the field before or during the sampling period.

fertilizer_type.descr: Type of fertilizer used, if applicable (e.g., manure, urea, compost, NPK blend).

pesticide_applied.descr: Whether pesticide or herbicide application occurred in the field before sampling.

irrigation_applied.descr: Whether the field was irrigated prior to sampling.

tillage_practice.descr: Tillage regime used at the site (e.g., no-till, reduced till, conventional till).

land_use_history.descr: Brief description of recent land use or crop rotation history relevant to interpretation.

replicate_number.descr: Replicate number for the sample within a field, site, or treatment group.

sample_type.descr: Sample category such as bulk soil, rhizosphere soil, or root-adhered soil.

dna_rna_extracted.descr: Indicates whether DNA, RNA, or both were extracted from the sample.

extraction_kit.descr: Nucleic acid extraction kit or protocol name.

extraction_protocol.descr: Brief description of the extraction procedure, including any bead-beating or purification steps.

extraction_date.descr: Date nucleic acid extraction was performed (YYYY-MM-DD).

extract_yield_ng_ul.descr: Concentration of extracted nucleic acid in ng/µL, if measured.

extract_purity_260_280.descr: Nucleic acid purity ratio A260/A280, if measured.

library_prep_kit.descr: Library preparation kit or protocol name used for sequencing.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing platform used (e.g., Illumina MiSeq, NovaSeq, PacBio, Oxford Nanopore).

sequencing_strategy.descr: Sequencing strategy or assay type (e.g., 16S rRNA amplicon, ITS amplicon, shotgun metagenomics, metatranscriptomics).

target_gene_region.descr: Targeted gene or region for amplicon sequencing, if applicable (e.g., 16S V3-V4, ITS1, ITS2).

primer_forward.descr: Forward primer sequence or identifier, if applicable.

primer_reverse.descr: Reverse primer sequence or identifier, if applicable.

read_length_bp.descr: Read length in base pairs for the primary sequencing reads.

sequencing_layout.descr: Sequencing layout such as single-end or paired-end.

barcode_index_scheme.descr: Indexing or barcoding scheme used to multiplex samples.

raw_reads_count.descr: Number of raw reads generated for this sample.

qc_reads_count.descr: Number of reads retained after quality control, if available.

qc_tool.descr: Software used for read quality control and filtering.

assembly_tool.descr: Assembler or contig-generation tool used, if applicable.

denoising_tool.descr: Denoising or amplicon processing tool used (e.g., DADA2, Deblur), if applicable.

taxonomic_assignment_tool.descr: Tool or database used for taxonomic assignment (e.g., QIIME2 classifier, SILVA, GTDB, UNITE).

functional_annotation_tool.descr: Tool or database used for functional annotation, if applicable.

normalization_method.descr: Method used to normalize counts or abundances (e.g., rarefaction, CSS, DESeq2 size factors).

relative_abundance_available.descr: Indicates whether relative abundance values were computed for this sample.

alpha_diversity_metric.descr: Alpha diversity metric reported for the sample, if applicable (e.g., Shannon, observed ASVs).

beta_diversity_group.descr: Group or treatment label used for downstream beta-diversity comparison.

biosample_identifier.descr: External accession or biosample ID in a repository, if available.

sequence_archive_accession.descr: Sequence archive accession identifier such as SRA, ENA, or DRA accession, if available.

notes.descr: Free-text notes on anomalies, deviations from protocol, or sample-specific caveats.
